about.intro: **Full Stack Developer** focused on building **modern, scalable, and sustainable** systems.
about.description: I am passionate about **learning new technologies** and turning ideas into real-world solutions. I develop *web*, *desktop*, and *mobile* applications, always prioritizing performance, simplicity, and an excellent user experience.
about.full:
Hello, I'm **Celio**. I have been involved in software development for several years, primarily as a self-taught developer, learning through my own projects and experiments.

Currently, I mainly work with web development, using technologies such as *React*, *TypeScript*, *Vite*, *Supabase*, *PostgreSQL*, *TailwindCSS*, *Electron*, *React Native*, and *Expo*. I also develop ERP systems, desktop and mobile applications, always focusing on performance, usability, and scalability.

Whenever a new technology or tool comes along, I enjoy experimenting with it. I am passionate about learning, and this constantly leads me to explore new areas, frameworks, and software architectures.

I place great importance on keeping my projects **clean, organized, and sustainable**. I am somewhat **perfectionist** in this regard; sometimes I end up making certain implementations more complex than necessary in order to maintain a high standard of quality.

My current goal is to specialize in **backend development, system architecture, and SaaS development**, making my projects increasingly professional. I also want to build my own systems, libraries, and tools that are simple, practical, and capable of solving real-world problems, especially through **HappyCash ERP**.

projects.title: HappyCash ERP
projects.description:
HappyCash ERP is a complete business management system designed to serve small and medium-sized businesses. The platform brings together sales management, POS, inventory, finance, reports, customers, credit accounts, and much more in a single environment.

The system was designed to provide performance, ease of use, and scalability, featuring cloud synchronization, offline functionality, web, desktop, and mobile applications, as well as an architecture prepared to grow alongside its customers' businesses.

projects.title: HappyCash Food
projects.description:
HappyCash Food is a digital menu platform designed for restaurants, snack bars, and pizzerias. It allows customers to place orders directly from their smartphones using a QR Code, making service faster and more organized.

Integrated with the HappyCash ecosystem, the system simplifies order management and improves the experience for both customers and businesses.

projects.title: HappyCash Agenda
projects.description:
HappyCash Agenda is a system designed to simplify schedule and appointment management for businesses that operate with bookings. The platform allows businesses to manage customers, services, professionals, and schedules in a simple and intuitive way.

The goal is to provide a practical, modern solution integrated with the rest of the HappyCash ecosystem.

roadmap.description: This was the period when I first became interested in software development. I learned the fundamentals of programming, logic, and algorithms, starting my first projects and exploring different technologies on my own.

I began developing more complete web applications, deepening my knowledge of front-end development and databases. I also started creating my first systems focused on management and process automation.

I started developing HappyCash ERP, focusing on building a modern business management system. During this period, I significantly improved my skills in application architecture, databases, and user experience.

I expanded HappyCash to new platforms by developing desktop and mobile versions. I also implemented features such as synchronization, authentication, payment integrations, and offline capabilities to provide a more complete experience.

Currently, my focus is on evolving HappyCash ERP into a professional SaaS platform, investing in system architecture, scalability, performance, and backend development, while continuing to explore new technologies to create increasingly robust solutions.
